programs.name: Claude for Open Source
requirements: 500+ dependent repos, OR 100+ dependent packages, OR 200k+ monthly downloads
OR listed maintainer on a recognised foundation project (CNCF, Apache PMC, Node TSC, etc.)
OR 100+ PRs merged into repos you do not own in last 12 months
OR 20+ unique external contributors in last 12 months
programs.notes: Rolling review, up to 10,000 maintainers accepted.

programs.name: Vercel Open Source Program
requirements: Actively developed and maintained OSS project
programs.notes: 3-year term, then you graduate out.

programs.name: Neon Open Source Program
programs.value_label: Up to $5,000/yr credits + GitHub Sponsors cash
requirements: Uses Postgres as a core component
Docs or examples showing Neon integration
programs.notes: Renewable yearly. Projects that make Neon a default option are prioritised.

programs.name: Codex for Open Source
programs.value_label: 6 mo ChatGPT Pro + API credits, grants up to $25,000
programs.notes: Part of a $1M open source fund.

programs.name: Project Alexandria
programs.value_label: Annual recurring credits (Workers, R2, Pages, Zero Trust)
requirements: Open source project using Cloudflare services

programs.name: Credits for Projects
requirements: Credit tier scales with star count
programs.notes: One of the few programmes with a genuinely low entry bar.

programs.name: Copilot Pro for Maintainers
requirements: Recognised maintainer of a popular OSS repo
programs.notes: Also free for verified students and teachers.

programs.name: Algolia for Open Source
programs.notes: DocSearch is the most common use.

programs.name: Open Source Licences
requirements: Publicly available source, no paid support tier

programs.name: CircleCI for Open Source
programs.value_label: Free build credits: Linux, Arm, macOS, Windows

programs.name: Semaphore for Open Source
programs.value_label: Unlimited CI/CD minutes, 4 Linux + 1 macOS parallel

programs.name: CodeRabbit for OSS
programs.value_label: Free AI code reviews on public repos
programs.notes: Backed by a $1M OSS sponsorship commitment.

programs.name: Non-profit / Open Source Plan
programs.value_label: Free Community plan with Ultimate features

programs.name: SonarQube Cloud for Open Source
programs.notes: Free for all open source projects, plus a free tier for private projects up to 50k lines. Their old application URL 404ed on 2026-09-19 and was corrected to the current page.

programs.name: SignPath Foundation
programs.notes: Genuinely valuable - commercial certs cost hundreds per year.

programs.name: Docker-Sponsored Open Source (DSOS)
programs.value_label: Verified badge, Scout, no pull rate limits

programs.name: FOSS Fund
programs.value_label: Direct cash sponsorship via engineer nominations
requirements: Must be nominated by a Microsoft engineer
Project must accept funds (GitHub Sponsors / Open Collective)
programs.notes: Cash, not credits.

programs.name: Cloudflare for Startups
requirements: Public website plus an active LinkedIn, X or GitHub presence
First-time applicants only, for-profit, business email on your own domain
programs.notes: The best-documented programme on this list. Tier 3 is explicitly for bootstrapped or self-funded startups with under $1M raised and needs no partner at all - you can apply directly for $10,000. Tiers 1 and 2 require funding from an affiliated partner within the last 12 months.

programs.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
programs.source_quote: up to $2,000 USD in credits to use over a year
requirements: Start tier: explicitly for startups not yet backed by equity funding - up to $2,000
Scale tier: requires startup equity funding - up to $100,000 in year one plus up to $100,000 in year two
AI startups: up to $350,000 in cloud cost coverage
Founded within 5 years of applying, or 10 years for Scale
Google Cloud account with a Billing ID, a public company website, and email on that same domain
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-19: an earlier check of cloud.google.com/startup hit a login wall, so this was marked unverified. The public page at startup.google.com/cloud publishes everything. The important find is the Start tier - $2,000 for founders with no investor at all, which almost no directory lists. No VC referral is required to apply.

programs.name: AWS Activate
programs.value_label: Up to $5,000 self-serve / up to $200,000 with a partner
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: AWS Activate Provider Org ID - obtained by joining a partner accelerator, incubator, VC or angel network
programs.source_quote: Activate Portfolio tier offers up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits
requirements: Pre-Series B, founded in the last 10 years
AWS account on a paid support plan
Founders tier: self-serve, starts at $1,000 and goes up to $5,000
Portfolio tier: needs an Activate Provider Org ID from a VC, accelerator or angel
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-19: the Portfolio ceiling is $200,000, not the $100,000 most directories quote, and the self-serve Founders tier goes to $5,000 rather than $1,000. A third invite-only AI tier sits above $200,000. AWS does not state how long credits stay valid.

programs.name: Neon for Startups
programs.value_label: Up to $1,000 self-funded / up to $200,000 combined with Databricks
requirements: Self-funded track: under $1M raised, early product or MVP, no investor needed
VC track: $1M+ raised, or a place in a recognised accelerator such as Y Combinator
programs.notes: Now a joint programme with Databricks - the $200,000 is combined across both. Credits last 12 months, and nothing is charged automatically when they run out.

programs.name: Databricks Startup Program
requirements: A clear use case and early momentum from design partners
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-19: relaunched as a joint programme with Neon at $200,000 combined, up from the $50,000 older directories still list. The application URL also moved.

programs.name: Microsoft for Startups
programs.value_label: Up to $150,000 Azure credits, unlocked over time
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: Microsoft for Startups Investor Network referral code - unlocks higher benefits earlier
programs.source_quote: Unlock up to $150K in Startup credits over time as your startup demonstrates verified progress, service adoption, and sustained Azure usage
requirements: Privately held, for-profit, and owns a software product or service
Headquartered in a country where Azure is available
Has not raised Series C or later
Has not received more than $350,000 in lifetime free Azure credits
NOT eligible: consultancies, agencies, educational institutions, government bodies or crypto mining
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-19 from Microsoft's own docs. Two things matter here. First, the $150,000 is unlocked gradually as you actually use Azure, not granted up front - credits start small. Second, agencies and consultancies are explicitly barred, which disqualifies a large number of people who assume they qualify. Applications are reviewed in about three business days. Azure credits also pay for OpenAI models through Microsoft Foundry.

programs.name: PostHog for Startups
requirements: PostHog does not state an age or funding cap on the programme page
programs.notes: One of the very few programmes that prints its actual number in public. Includes analytics, session replay, feature flags and error tracking.

programs.name: Claude for Startups
programs.value_label: Free credits + priority rate limits (amounts not published)
requirements: Equity funding from an institutional investor
Must not have received Anthropic startup credits before
Claude Console account and a company email address
programs.notes: Anthropic's own page contradicts itself: the FAQ lists institutional equity funding as a requirement, then states the programme is open to founders with or without VC backing. No figures are published anywhere official - third parties report $5,000 direct and $25,000 with a VC referral. Mention your investor when you apply.

programs.name: IBM for Startups
requirements: Reported: under 5 years old, under $1M revenue, working MVP, not a current IBM customer
programs.notes: Checked 2026-09-19: could not find these terms anywhere on ibm.com. Every figure here comes from third-party directories. Verify before spending time on an application.

programs.name: Oracle for Startups
requirements: Reported: under 10 years old, working MVP, not a current Oracle customer
programs.notes: Checked 2026-09-19: oracle.com/startup returns 403 to automated checks, so nothing here is confirmed from source. Verify manually before applying.

programs.name: DigitalOcean for Startups (Hatch)
programs.value_label: Amount not published - set by your partner
requirements: Company website and a matching business email address
AI-native startups are prioritised; consultancies and agencies are not eligible
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-19: DigitalOcean publishes no award amounts at all, so the $100,000 other directories quote is unsourced. Bootstrapped founders can still apply directly by selecting 'Other' as the partner organisation. A $10,000/month spend cap is mentioned.

programs.name: Together AI Startup Program
programs.notes: Checked 2026-09-19: the startup programme form returns 404 and no public page states the amount. $100 free on signup is separate and does work. 200+ open models including Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen.

programs.name: Mistral Startup Program
requirements: Early-stage startup building on Mistral models
programs.notes: Checked 2026-09-19: no public page states terms or amounts. Verify on application.

programs.name: OpenAI Startup Credits
programs.notes: OpenAI no longer runs a general startup credits programme, yet several directories still list it. To reach OpenAI models on credits, use Microsoft for Startups Azure credits through Microsoft Foundry instead. Their Codex for Open Source programme is separate and does still run.

programs.name: NVIDIA Inception
programs.value_label: Free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners - amount not published
programs.source_quote: Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners for more flexible, scalable development and deployment.
requirements: Open to startups at any funding stage
No application fee and no cohort deadline
programs.notes: No fixed amount is published. Worth applying anyway because there is no deadline, no cost and no funding-stage bar - unusually open compared with everything else on this page.

programs.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
programs.value_label: Up to ₹20 lakh grant, plus up to ₹50 lakh investment or debt
programs.source_quote: Up to Rs. 20 Lakhs as grant
requirements: Incorporated no more than 2 years before applying
You apply through an approved incubator, not directly to the government
programs.notes: This is cash, not credits, and the ₹20 lakh portion is a grant you do not repay - for proof of concept, prototype or product trials. The larger ₹50 lakh portion is debt or convertible instruments for going to market. The two-year age limit is strict, so apply early.

programs.name: Section 80-IAC Tax Exemption
programs.source_quote: 100% tax deduction for three consecutive financial years
requirements: Incorporated on or after 1 April 2016 and under 10 years old
programs.notes: Not money in, but money you keep - three years of profits taxed at zero. Worth nothing until you are profitable, and worth a great deal the moment you are. The value depends entirely on your profit, so no figure can be quoted.

programs.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups
programs.value_label: Government guarantee on borrowing, up to ₹20 crore per startup
programs.source_quote: maximum limit from INR 10 crore to INR 20 crore per eligible borrower
requirements: Borrowing arranged through an approved Member Institution
You approach the lender; you do not apply to the government directly
programs.notes: Read this one carefully: it is NOT ₹20 crore of free money. The government guarantees your loan, which lets banks lend without demanding the collateral a young company cannot provide. You still repay the loan.

programs.name: NIDHI Seed Support Programme
programs.source_quote: maximum support that will be given to a deserving startup is up to INR 100 lakh
requirements: Apply through a participating Technology Business Incubator, not to DST directly
Each incubator runs its own calls on its own timetable
programs.notes: The largest single figure in India's public schemes. Because access runs through incubators, getting into a good TBI is the real unlock - the same pattern as cloud partner tiers.

programs.name: NIDHI PRAYAS 2.0
programs.value_label: Up to ₹20 lakh, or ₹40 lakh via Advance PRAYAS Centres
programs.source_quote: funding support of up to INR 40 Lakhs per innovator/startup
requirements: Selected through a PRAYAS Centre or Advance PRAYAS Centre
programs.notes: Aimed at the stage before you have anything to sell - money specifically to build the prototype. Advance PRAYAS Centres handle deeptech and harder hardware builds.

programs.name: NIDHI Entrepreneur-in-Residence
programs.value_label: ₹10,000–₹30,000 a month for up to 12 months
programs.source_quote: financial support of up to INR 30,000/- monthly
requirements: Aimed at graduate students and first-time entrepreneurs
programs.notes: This pays YOU, not the company - a salary while you work on the idea. Close to unique, and the right starting point for a student or someone who cannot yet afford to quit a job.

programs.name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
programs.value_label: ₹50 lakh grant-in-aid over up to 18 months
programs.source_quote: early-stage funding support of INR 50 Lakhs as grant-in-aid
requirements: Early stage, working toward proof of concept
programs.notes: Grant-in-aid means you do not repay it and give up no equity. Calls open roughly twice a year. If you are in biotech this is among the best-value money available anywhere.

programs.name: GENESIS / GEN-NEXT Support for Innovative Startups
programs.value_label: ₹10 lakh early stage, ₹50 lakh pilot, up to ₹1 crore deeptech
programs.source_quote: upper ceiling of Rs. 1 Cr per startup
requirements: Deliberately targets Tier-II and Tier-III cities
Each funding component has its own criteria
programs.notes: Specifically designed for founders outside Bengaluru, Delhi and Mumbai. If you are building somewhere smaller, this scheme was written with you in mind and competition is lighter.

programs.name: SAMRIDH
programs.source_quote: one-to-one matching funding support of up to INR 40 lakh
requirements: Funding is matched one-to-one, so you need an investor alongside it
programs.notes: Matching means the government puts in roughly what an investor puts in. You need to raise the other half first, so this suits startups already in conversation with investors.

programs.name: ELEVATE
programs.value_label: Up to ₹50 lakh main track / up to ₹50 lakh Minorities track / up to ₹1 crore milestone track
programs.source_quote: Selected startup will be eligible for up to ₹1 crore in grant in aid support.
requirements: Previous ELEVATE winners may be restricted
ELEVATE Minorities: a Director or Partner must belong to a recognised minority community and hold at least 51% equity
ELEVATE Minorities: that Director or Partner needs a valid digital Minority Certificate from the Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka, with an RD Number
Turnover must not exceed ₹300 crore in any financial year since incorporation
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-20: we listed only the ₹50 lakh headline and missed a milestone-based track worth up to ₹1 crore, plus the separate ELEVATE Minorities track and its 51% equity and Minority Certificate conditions. The 2026 call closed on 15 July 2026; the scheme runs repeatedly, so watch the portal for the next round rather than applying now. Grants pay out against milestones, not in one lump.

programs.name: Startup Odisha Financial Incentives
programs.value_label: ₹20,000/month allowance, plus product development assistance up to ₹16 lakh
programs.source_quote: Product Development and Marketing/ Publicity assistance up to Rs. 15 lakh (Upto Rs.16 lakhs, if the startup Founder (s)/Co-Founder (s) is Woman or transgender or from Social Categories such as SC/ST/SEBC/PH
requirements: Monthly allowance is Rs 20,000, or Rs 22,000 if a founder is a woman, transgender, or from SC/ST/SEBC/PH

The product development grant needs equity financing of at least Rs 25 lakh, OR a central/state government grant of at least Rs 5 lakh, OR a revenue run rate of Rs 2.5 lakh a month over the last six months
Bills and utilisation reports may be required
programs.notes: Corrected 2026-09-20: we led with the Rs 20,000 monthly allowance and buried the bigger benefit under 'further assistance'. Product development and marketing assistance runs to Rs 15 lakh, or Rs 16 lakh if a founder is a woman, transgender or from SC/ST/SEBC/PH - about six times the annual allowance - and carries its own eligibility gate. The enhanced Rs 22,000 allowance rate was also missing. Every Indian state runs something like this; if you are not in Odisha, search your own state's startup policy.

programs.name: Razorpay Rize
programs.value_label: Bundle of third-party tool deals - headline $500,000 is an advertised aggregate
programs.source_quote: Get $500,000 in credits for tools like AWS, Canva, Notion, and more.
requirements: Founder, admitted selectively to one of the Rize communities
Primarily aimed at founders building in India
programs.notes: We deliberately do not record $500,000 as a value. It is the advertised sum of many separate third-party offers added together, not credits Razorpay awards you, and there is no published AWS-specific amount. Treat it as a useful bundle of discounts and a founder community, not half a million dollars.

programs.name: ElevenLabs Grants
programs.source_quote: 33,000,000 characters. That's over 680 hours of Agents usage. More than $5,500+ in value.
requirements: Must have a business or monetisation strategy - not a hobby project
NOT eligible: agencies, consulting firms, existing enterprise customers
Not for products aimed at under-18s
programs.notes: One of the very few AI programmes with a published value AND no investor requirement. If you are building anything with voice, this is among the best returns for an hour of application work on the whole page.

programs.name: MongoDB for Startups
programs.value_label: Atlas credits across 4 tiers - amounts not published
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: A VC or accelerator referral moves you up the tier ladder
programs.source_quote: If you are not involved with a VC, accelerator, or incubator, please apply above on this page.
requirements: Under 7 years old, Series A or earlier
NOT eligible: development shops and agencies
Active company website and LinkedIn profile
Not previously accepted into the programme
programs.notes: MongoDB states plainly that bootstrapped founders should apply directly, and 'Bootstrapped' is an option on their own form - unusually welcoming. The four tiers are named but no amounts are published for any of them.

programs.name: Intercom Early Stage
programs.source_quote: Up to $10M in funding
requirements: Raised up to $10M in funding - bootstrapped is fine
programs.notes: A discount, not credits, so no dollar figure is recorded. Year one includes the Fin AI agent free with 300 outcomes a month. No age limit is stated - only funding and headcount.

programs.name: HubSpot for Startups
programs.value_label: 90% off year 1 with funding, or 30% via a partner org
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: Approved HubSpot for Startups partner organisation
programs.source_quote: Raised Pre-seed, Seed or Series A funding, but not Series B or later
requirements: Either verified venture funding (checked via Crunchbase or PitchBook), OR affiliation with an approved partner organisation
Pre-seed, Seed or Series A - not Series B or later
Applies only to new Professional or Enterprise products
programs.notes: A discount, not credits. Fully bootstrapped founders with no partner affiliation are not listed as an eligible category - this is one of the few programmes where having raised nothing genuinely shuts the door.

programs.name: Notion for Startups
programs.value_label: 3 months free alone, 6 with a partner (up to $12,000 value)
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: A select Notion startup partner doubles 3 months to 6
programs.source_quote: For non-paying Notion customers with under 100 employees and are affiliated with one of our select startup partners
requirements: Under 100 employees and not already paying for Notion
Valid company domain email - Gmail and Outlook addresses are rejected
programs.notes: The headline $12,000 assumes 100 employees; a small team gets a fraction of that, which is why no figure is recorded here. Bootstrapped founders can apply alone for 3 months.

programs.name: Modal for Startups
programs.unlocks_partner_tier: Modal VC partner network - any amount raised from a partner fund qualifies
programs.source_quote: Unlock thousands of free GPU credits to supercharge your startup.
requirements: Seed to Series A: any VC money from Modal's partner network, OR over $1M raised from any fund
Series B+: over $30M raised AND the VC must be in Modal's partner network
programs.notes: Hard requirement: there is no route in without venture funding. Worth knowing so you don't waste time - but note that ANY amount from a partner fund qualifies, so a small cheque from the right investor is enough.

programs.name: Fireworks AI Startup Program
programs.value_label: Inference credits, expire after 1 year - amount not published
programs.source_quote: Venture backed startups with >$500k in funding
requirements: Registered company with a working website
programs.notes: The $500k funding floor is explicit, so bootstrapped founders are out. Credits expire after 12 months.
